notes.title: Cozy Blocks is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Trenga is now Cozy Blocks![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40401640/c058325468e57a3d2ed5fd4a0dbc2b6acbde2e37.jpg[/img]

We are so proud to announce the major overhaul to our cozy puzzle game! After carefully hearing feedback from players, we designed changes to the core gameplay to make this the ultimate block puzzle experience!

[h2]Take Your Time: [/h2]No pressure, no timers. We removed the oxygen mechanic from the main gameplay mode. Analyze the blocks and choose your strategy at your own pace.

[h2]Buddies Update:[/h2] Buddies mechanics now do not involve time, they are all chill! Check them out!

[h2]Cozy, Accessible, Fun Gameplay:[/h2] great for all ages, from grandkids to grandparents!

We hope you all enjoy this new approach to the gameplay and let your worries flow away in Cozy Block's beautiful sea!
